name: youtube-exact-upload-date
description: Firefox, Chromium and Safari extension that replaces YouTube relative video dates with exact dates.

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files test scripts safari dist .playwright-browsers AGENTS.md package-lock.json .github README.md LICENSE
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --ignore-files test scripts safari dist .playwright-browsers AGENTS.md package-lock.json .github README.md LICENSE
scripts.build:chromium: node scripts/build-chromium.mjs && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chromium/extension --artifacts-dir dist/chromium --overwrite-dest --filename youtube-exact-upload-date-chromium-{version}.zip
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint
